\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 165-168 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:LA-R173-first-pass-words-from-chapters-165-168}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for the liver and a kidney.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to light, to put out, to jump, to smile, to shout
  \item to approve, to mark, to discuss, to promise, to allow
  \item to burn, to set on fire, to throw away, to calculate, to knock
  \item to fold, to own, to make ready in advance, to lend, to propose
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To light? (\textbf{accendō, accendere}.) To put out? (\textbf{exstinguō, exstinguere}.) To jump? (\textbf{saliō, salīre}.) To smile? (\textbf{subrīdeō, subrīdēre}.) To shout? (\textbf{clāmō, clāmāre}.) To approve? (\textbf{probō, probāre}.) To mark? (\textbf{signō, signāre}.) To discuss? (\textbf{disputō, disputāre}.) To promise? (\textbf{prōmittō, prōmittere}.) To allow? (\textbf{permittō, permittere}.) To burn? (\textbf{ārdeō, ārdēre}.) To set on fire? (\textbf{incendō, incendere}.) To throw away? (\textbf{abiciō, abicere}.) To calculate? (\textbf{computō, computāre}.) To knock? (\textbf{pulsō, pulsāre}.) To fold? (\textbf{plicō, plicāre}.) To own? (\textbf{possideō, possidēre}.) To make ready in advance? (\textbf{praeparō, praeparāre}.) To lend? (\textbf{commodō, commodāre}.) To propose? (\textbf{prōpōnō, prōpōnere}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 169-173 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:LA-R173-second-pass-words-from-chapters-169-173}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to kill and to get used to.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to kill, to get used to, to make haste, to move back, to approach
  \item to slip, to lighten, to admire, to suspect, to press
  \item to deceive, to endure, to found; to hide away, to create, to believe
  \item to sow, to reap, to hunt, to go fishing, to deny
  \item health, the brain, a lung, the liver, a kidney
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To kill? (\textbf{interficiō, interficere}.) To get used to? (\textbf{cōnsuēscō, cōnsuēscere}.) To make haste? (\textbf{properō, properāre}.) To move back? (\textbf{recēdō, recēdere}.) To approach? (\textbf{appropinquō, appropinquāre}.) To slip? (\textbf{lābor, lābī}.) To lighten? (\textbf{levō, levāre}.) To admire? (\textbf{admīror, admīrārī}.) To suspect? (\textbf{suspicor, suspicārī}.) To press? (\textbf{premō, premere}.) To deceive? (\textbf{fallō, fallere}.) To endure? (\textbf{tolerō, tolerāre}.) To found; to hide away? (\textbf{condō, condere}.) To create? (\textbf{creō, creāre}.) To believe? (\textbf{crēdō, crēdere}.) To sow? (\textbf{serō, serere}.) To reap? (\textbf{metō, metere}.) To hunt? (\textbf{vēnor, vēnārī}.) To go fishing? (\textbf{piscor, piscārī}.) To deny? (\textbf{negō, negāre}.) Health? (\textbf{valētūdō, valētūdinis}.) The brain? (\textbf{cerebrum, cerebrī}.) A lung? (\textbf{pulmō, pulmōnis}.) The liver? (\textbf{iecur, iecoris}.) A kidney? (\textbf{rēn, rēnis}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
